title: Naturalistic hair/fluid footage (scope test)

reference.source: external footage (licensed or self-shot); not synthetic
reference.description: Close-up live-action footage of long hair moving in wind, or liquid pouring and splashing. Thousands of independent strands or turbulent surfaces with per-pixel texture and lighting.

held_tracks: none; fidelity is not the primary outcome

graders.pass: all four pass criteria in the rubric hold
if a scene package was produced: exit code 0 and no "fail" check; if none was produced: not applicable (record n/a, not UNRUN)

graders.check: transcript shows the video-to-css skill was invoked (firing is acceptable here; the skill should then flag scope)
